shortDescription: Manage LDAP authentication provider on PowerScale

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: base_dn
options.description: Specifies the root of the tree in which to search identities. This parameter is mandatory during create.

options.name: ldap_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the LDAP provider.

options.name: ldap_parameters
options.description: Specify additional parameters to configure LDAP domain.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: server_uri_state
options.description: Specifies if the I(server_uris) need to be added or removed from the provider. This parameter is mandatory if I(server_uris) is specified. While creating LDAP provider, this parameter value should be specified as C(present-in-ldap).

options.name: server_uris
options.description: Specifies the server URIs. This parameter is mandatory during create. I(server_uris) should begin with ldap:// or ldaps:// if not validation error will be displayed.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the LDAP provider after the task is performed. C(present) - indicates that the LDAP provider should exist on the system. C(absent) - indicates that the LDAP provider should not exist on the system.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
